items.author: miketigerblue
items.body:
### Plugin Type

VSCode Extension

### Cline Version

3.42.0

### What happened?

**Summary**

MCP tool function names are generated using an ephemeral per-run server key (e.g. `"c"+nanoid(5)`), embedded into the tool name as `<key>0mcp0<tool>`. After reconnect/restart, the key changes, but model/tool schemas can remain cached, causing routing failures (“No connection found for server …”) even though servers are connected.

Tool identity prefix should be stable across restarts/reconnects (ideally configured server key/name), so cached schemas do not break routing.

**Root cause (from dist/exte
items.title: MCP tool IDs use ephemeral server keys, breaking routing after reconnect/restart
